name: opencode-comments-plugin
description: OpenCode plugin that warns on new comments/docstrings using comment-checker
author: YeonGyu-Kim

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin && bun build src/bin.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
